heading: Meet the Team
intro: The people who help bring the magic to Sane Living Center, from the first walk-through to the last song.

members.name: Karol Avalon
members.role: Director of Special Events & Operations Manager
members.bio:
With more than four decades in hospitality and events, Karol is one of the steady pulses of Sane Living Center’s heartbeat. As Director of Special Events and Operations Manager, she guides each gathering from the first walk-through to the final farewell and keeps the Center running smoothly day to day, bringing calm organization, warm hospitality and an eye for the details that make an event feel effortless.

Her career has spanned producing inspirational conferences and retreats, creating and leading multi-day events at sea with Life Journeys Global production company, providing sales and marketing expertise to Sonoma County boutique inns and serving as Vice President of Merchandising for the Red Rose Collection. She brings every bit of her vast experience to each client who walks through Sane Living’s purple doors.
